purpose: Examples only. The server reads environment variables; it does not auto-load this file. See docs/deployment.md for the explicit profile launcher.

reference.description: Default bundled public structure replay; no model parameters or GPU required.

colabfold-local.description: Example for an already installed ColabFold environment. This profile uses single-sequence mode; full local MSA must be configured explicitly. Replace executable and runtime version with installed values.

alphafold3-local.description: Example for an authorized, installed official AF3 runtime. Paths must exist in the same filesystem namespace as the launched executable. Weight authorization is separate from the code license.

alphafold2-local.description: Uses the included scripts/af2_runner.py with an existing official AF2 v2.3.2-compatible environment. Replace Python, project, database paths and template cutoff with the actual installation. The runner applies requested recycles and exports safe confidence JSON.

optional_local_gpu_pool.description: Example only: enable on a host with these physical GPU IDs. Each job leases one group; the runner must implement any actual intra-group parallelism. Do not combine this local pool with a remote scheduler wrapper.

staged_campaign_configuration: Use config/staged-engines.example.json and config/databases.example.json; see docs/staged-runners.md and docs/database-and-batch-pipeline.md. This file remains the direct whole-job configuration.
